subject: From an old friend
body:
Hi! It's me, your old friend Trayaurus. Grim says hello. He's here with me and doing well, and he's forgiven me for the cloning machine.

Something strange happened. I woke up one morning and the whole lab was in Elythia. I don't know how it got here, or how I did.

So I've started a book. It's called The Big Boogaloo, and it's going to have everything in it about this strange new multiverse. Twelve pages so far. They're on your phone, in the Archive. If you ever pick something up and don't know what it is, hold W over it and I'll open the right page.

I'd do the research myself, but I'm not really leaving the lab at the moment. Also, I've found out about something called the Infinity Gauntlet. I'll explain later.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
